questions.text: «It is recommended that he ___ » — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: recommend + that + V1 (asos shakl) — mandative subjunctive.
I would recommend taking / It is recommended that steps be taken.

Balansli baho: yaxshi tomonlar + kamchiliklar.

Ijobiy tavsiya: a must-see, highly recommend, well worth + -ing.

questions.explanation: Mandative subjunctive: that + ega + V1.
